sources.summary: The first production model of the electric Ferrari designed by Jony Ive and Marc Newson has sold for $40 million – a record price for a new vehicle at auction. The carmaker's polarising first foray into EVs, the Ferrari Luce, went under the hammer as part of a RM Sotheby's charity auction at Monterey Car The post Ferrari's controversial first EV sells for record $40 million at auction appeared first on Dezeen .
